title: Answer: the self is the one engaged in probing, explained by its functions

statements.text: The founding papers give no theory of the self. O’Regan later treats the for-me character of experience as tied to the self engaged in exploratory probing, and expects it to be explained by the cognitive, attentional and social functions of the self.

sources.quote: be given an explanation in terms of the cognitive, attentional and also social functions of the self
